title: Write a professional email to reschedule a meeting

messages.content: Write a professional email to reschedule a meeting

Subject: Request to Reschedule Our Meeting – [Original Date & Time]

Dear [Recipient’s Name],

I hope you are doing well. I am writing to request a brief adjustment to our scheduled meeting on **[Original Date] at [Original Time]**.

Due to an unforeseen commitment that requires my immediate attention, I will be unable to attend at the originally planned time. I sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

Could we please move our discussion to **[Proposed New Date] at [Proposed New Time]**? I believe this time will still allow us to address all the agenda items without interruption. If that slot does not fit your schedule, I am happy to accommodate any alternative dates and times that work best for you.

Thank you very much for your understanding and flexibility. I appreciate your cooperation and look forward to our conversation.

Please let me know if the new time is convenient or if you would like to propose another.

Best regards,

[Your Full Name]  
[Your Title]  
[Your Company/Organization]  
[Phone Number] | [Email Address]  
[Website (optional)]
